title: SecOps rundown, Wed 21 Oct afternoon: 17 critical, 12 advisories

items.title: PHP2Shell: What Actually Protects You Before the 14:00 UTC PHP RCE Patch, and What Doesn't
items.summary: You cannot fully block the two critical PHP flaws called PHP2Shell before today's fix, and the one setting being passed around as a workaround is not enough on its own, the security firm that suggested it now says.

items.title: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws
items.summary: The PHP security team released emergency security patches for two critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) tracked collectively as PHP2Shell. [...]

items.title: PHP2Shell: Mass Exploitation Looms for Leaked Critical PHP Flaws
items.summary: Tracked as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, the bugs could potentially lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

items.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
items.summary: This story is developing and was written before PHP's scheduled 14:00 UTC release on October 21. Once the release is out, the affected and fixed versions below are confirmed by the official advisory.

items.title: CISA: SafePay ransomware hit over 600 critical infrastructure orgs
